# garage_cluster_layout (Data Source)

Read the current Garage cluster layout.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "garage_cluster_layout" "current" {}

output "layout_version" {
  value = data.garage_cluster_layout.current.version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `partition_size` (Number) Size in bytes of one partition.
- `roles` (Attributes List) Current node roles. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))
- `version` (Number) Current layout version.

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `capacity` (Number) Assigned capacity (bytes).
- `id` (String) Node ID.
- `stored_partitions` (Number) Number of stored partitions.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags.
- `usable_capacity` (Number) Usable capacity (bytes).
- `zone` (String) Zone name.
